stories.title: Steve Sarkisian walks out on Holly Rowe
stories.summary: After No. 4 Texas beat No. 1 Ohio State 24-23 with a 21-point comeback, coach Steve Sarkisian walked away from Holly Rowe's postgame interview seconds in, leaving her to walk off alone. A clip of the snub got 29K likes, and Sark, Holly Rowe and #HookEm trended the next day.
